newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Refugio gold mine output at 3.1 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Refugio gold mine output at 3.1 tonnes.

text.p: Chile's Refugio gold mine produced 102,000 ounces, or 3.1 tonnes, of gold since the pit started operating in April last year, said Canada's Bema Gold Corp, which owns 50 percent of the project.
The mine, half-owned by Cyprus Amax Mineral Co -controlled Amax Gold Corp, is operating at around 50 percent of its design capacity of 230,000 ounces.
The companies are exploiting a deposit known as Verde and are exploring two new areas called Pancho and Guanaco, it said.
If these two areas are mined, then the pit's production will climb to 300,000 ounces a year with the mine's active life doubled from nine to 18 years.
Bema Gold also owns the Cerro Casale deposit which could produce around 12 tonnes of gold a year, making it one of the world's largest gold mines.
Bema executives will hold a news conference in Santiago at 1100 local (1400 GMT) Wednesday to give details of their company's projects in Chile.
